(2) It has Samuṭṭhānasīsa which should know as Theyyasathta (party of thieves). (3) (Vinaya etc.,) which has Samuṭṭhāna which is like the Samuṭṭhāna of Theyyasathta Vinaya. (Samuṭṭhāna means arising (from); originating (from); due (to); based (on); lit. Standing up together). (Sīsa means lead; head;  (of a battle) front; forefront; front line; lit. head).

theyyasatthasikkhāpada.p: [Theyyasattha+sikkhāpada] (na) CL=7 Theyyasattha - Vinaya, A vinaya which disciplines for a Bhikkhu who ordinary Bhikkhu and he discusses with a merchant who is a thief , they are traveling 'together' a journey. Vinayapiṭaka, pācittiyapāḷi, 5-kaṇḍa, 7-vaga, 6- Vinayas.
a: ထေယျသတ္ထသိက္ခာပဒ(န)
[ထေယျသတ္ထ+သိက္ခာပဒ]
